limitations: Best-effort public-web snapshot; booking-only, private-quote, login-only, unindexed or phone-only prices may be absent.

Historical_public_directory and patient_reported rows should be excluded from the default Explore card unless no current official price exists and the UI clearly labels the source/date.
Hair-transplant directory pricing is explicitly marked and should rank below official clinic-site pricing.
Greater Orlando includes Winter Park, Maitland, Altamonte Springs, Lake Mary, Ocoee, Celebration and Longwood.
